insights: The identity holds over any CommRing -- Ptolemy is purely algebraic, geometry enters only through the norm

This yields the inequality form, not equality -- equality requires concyclicity characterization
dist_eq_norm bridges the complex proof to the classical geometric statement

The sufficient condition for equality (positive proportionality of opposite-side products) corresponds geometrically to the four points being concyclic in the standard ordering
